requirements: Swag Labs e-commerce web application at https://www.saucedemo.com/. Test the login functionality for ALL accepted user types with password 'secret_sauce': standard_user (valid login, then end-to-end shopping journey: view inventory, add item to cart, checkout with first/last name and postal code, finish order, logout), locked_out_user (login must be blocked with 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'), problem_user (login succeeds but inventory product images are broken/wrong), performance_glitch_user (login succeeds but is delayed by several seconds), error_user (login succeeds but checkout/save step shows errors), visual_user (login succeeds but visual mismatches appear on inventory). Also verify invalid username/password shows 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service' and that logout returns to the login screen.
acceptance_criteria: 1) standard_user logs in successfully, completes add-to-cart and full checkout, and logs out. 2) locked_out_user cannot log in and sees the locked-out error. 3) problem_user logs in but product images fail to load correctly on inventory page. 4) performance_glitch_user logs in successfully with a noticeable delay. 5) error_user logs in but checkout save step errors. 6) visual_user logs in but visual mismatch issues appear. 7) Invalid credentials show the generic 'Epic sadface' error. 8) All error messages appear in the login error container with a close (X) button.
application_context: Swag Labs demo e-commerce web application at https://www.saucedemo.com/ (Selenium's saucedemo sample app). Pages: login page (#user-name, #password, #login-button), inventory page (.inventory_item, .inventory_item_img, .inventory_item_name), cart page (.cart_item), checkout step one (#first-name, #last-name, #postal-code, #continue), checkout step two (#finish), checkout complete (.complete-header). Users: standard_user, locked_out_user, problem_user, performance_glitch_user, error_user, visual_user; password: secret_sauce.
